test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: What should come in the place of blank number (3)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**datafied**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the reduction of human subjectivity by algorithmic systems that utilize "predictive modeling" and "biometric calibration."
 
• The phrase "**probabilistic matrix of behavioral speculation**" describes a system that calculates and predicts actions based on quantifiable inputs.
 
• "**Datafied**" perfectly captures this concept, referring to the process where a "sovereign self" is quantified and converted into mere data points within an algorithmic system.
 
• Other options ("**recursive**", "**relational**", "**dormant**") do not fit the specific context of an individual being quantified for algorithmic speculation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage Snippet: *...Agency, in this schema, is not exercised but programmed; it is neither given nor seized but orchestrated through micro-environmental cues and algorithmic affordances. The individual becomes less a sovereign self than a 3. **datafied**__ node in a probabilistic matrix of behavioral speculation. Within this ontological reconfiguration, resistance too undergoes a semiotic shift...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Recursive (पुनरावर्ती): Involving a process that repeats or refers back to itself. This doesn't fit the context of a person being reduced to raw material for a system.
 
• Relational (संबंधपरक): Concerning the way in which things are connected. While nodes are relational, "datafied" better conveys the loss of human agency to computational speculation.
 
• Dormant (निष्क्रिय): Temporarily inactive. This contradicts the highly active, probabilistic system described in the text.

50:Tf92,
T
